banner.title: 🥚 How to raise your buddy
banner.body: It grows as you chat and take care of it, with a bonus when you both talk on the same day. A reward appears on the stage every 5 levels, and at level 30 it can go its own way.

care.title: 🍚 Care
care.feed: When it is hungry the bowl is empty. Tap the bowl, or send just "food" in the chat.
care.clean: Each tap cleans up one 💩. Send "clean" in the chat to clean them all.
care.pet: Tap your buddy and it cheers, dances or sings.

grow.title: 🌱 Growing
grow.exp: EXP: +1 per message (up to 50 a day), +2 for a meal, +2 per 💩 cleaned.
grow.stages: Egg → baby (Lv.3) → child (Lv.10) → adult (Lv.20). From child on, it talks.
grow.together: When you both send a message on the same day, you get a together bonus of +{{exp}} EXP once a day. 🤝

rewards.title: 🎁 Level rewards
rewards.body: Every 5 levels the stage gets a little finer.

graduate.title: 🎓 Its own way
graduate.top: The top level is 30. Then you can let your buddy go its own way from its details.
graduate.album: It stays in the album and hangs on the wall in a frame. A new egg comes to the stage.
graduate.keep: The rewards you collected stay with the new egg.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: puny-chat provides invite-only, one-to-one text chat and a shared Buddy. This policy explains the information we process and your choices.

operator.title: 1. Operator and contact
operator.body: The individual operator of puny-chat manages personal information. Send support and privacy requests to {{email}}.

collection.title: 2. Information processed
collection.body: We process your account identifier (Firebase UID), display name, creation and recent activity times, guest/link status, room membership and invitations. We store message text, send times, read positions, and Buddy and album state. If you enable notifications, we process device push tokens or web push subscriptions. Google or Apple processes login information such as your email when you link an account; the app may display it to identify your account. Questions and reports include your message, selected reason, related user/room identifiers. Reply emails collected by earlier versions follow the retention period for existing submissions. Reports retain up to 50 recent text messages separately. Network and hosting operations may process IP addresses, request times and error information.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Information is used for authentication and account management, invitations, message delivery and recovery, Buddy state, notifications you enable, reviewing questions, report review and ending conversations, security and troubleshooting. We do not sell personal information or use conversations for targeted advertising. The service currently has no advertising or separate behavioral analytics tools.

sharing.title: 4. Conversations and reports
sharing.body: Messages are shared with your room partner. Reporting or removing a partner ends their membership, invalidates existing invites and deletes the conversation for both people. The person initiating removal keeps the Buddy and album. Report evidence is kept separately for operator review and is not shared with the reported person or other users. Submission content may be sent to the operator by email. Information may be disclosed to relevant authorities where legally required and only to the necessary extent.

providers.title: 5. Service providers and international processing
providers.body: Google Firebase Authentication provides sign-in and processes authentication data in the United States. MongoDB Atlas and Railway store chat/service data and operate the server; the current service region is Singapore. Cloudflare delivers the website and network security and may process technical information across its global network. Notifications pass through Expo, Apple or your browser push provider. App inquiry and report notifications go directly to the operator's Google Gmail inbox through the Gmail API. Email sent to the public contact address passes through Cloudflare Email Routing. Email content may be processed on these providers' global infrastructure. These providers process information to supply their services, including necessary international network transfers during use. Contact us with questions or requests about international processing.

retention.title: 6. Retention and deletion
retention.body: Account and service data are retained while you use the service. Delete your account in Settings. If your partner remains after ordinary room departure, their room, Buddy and shared conversation remain. Account deletion removes messages you sent and system records containing your name, including in rooms you previously left, and removes your actor information from care events. Your partner’s messages, room, Buddy and album remain. When the last member leaves, the room and conversation are deleted. Reporting/removal deletes the conversation for both people, while report evidence is retained separately. Server records for questions, reports and removals become eligible for automatic deletion 90 days after submission and are removed by the database cleanup cycle. Operator email copies are manually deleted when no longer needed after handling. Unlinked guest accounts are cleaned up by Firebase after 30 days from creation; expired guest service data is cleaned up periodically. Technical security/error information follows the relevant infrastructure provider retention policies.

security.title: 7. Safeguards
security.body: We use HTTPS/WSS and verify authentication and current room membership. Report evidence is not exposed through public APIs and is available only to people with operational access. Chat is not end-to-end encrypted: the server processes conversation content as needed to provide the service and handle reports.

rights.title: 8. Your choices and rights
rights.body: Change your display name, turn off device notifications, leave a room or delete your account in Settings. Send access, correction, deletion or processing restriction requests to {{email}}. We verify identity and consider other users’ rights before responding under applicable law. Questions and reports do not require a reply email.

children.title: 9. Children
children.body: This service is not directed to children under 13. Contact us if you believe information from such a child has been collected; we will verify and take appropriate action, including deletion.

changes.title: 10. Changes
changes.body: We update this page and its effective date when the policy changes. Significant changes to purposes or sharing are announced in the app or service website, with separate consent where required.
